title: BattleBit Remastered

custody.condition: Account-bound license on the archive Steam account. No physical media is part of this accession.

curatorNotes: Reserved for curator writing on BattleBit Remastered as a large-scale multiplayer digital holding. Co-developers Vilaskis and TheLiquidHorse are recorded on the Steam block.
collectionNotes: Ownership is digital only. The retained object is the Steam license. Official cover artwork has been entered from Steam library art; collection photography does not apply.

preservation.playableOn: Windows PC through Steam under archive custody
preservation.compatibility: Continued access requires the archive account, Steam’s support for the title, and BattleBit online services.
preservation.concerns: Massively multiplayer Early Access-era holdings face elevated server and update risk. No offline installer is held.
preservation.knownRevisions: Steam lists June 15, 2023 and continues to tag Early Access on the storefront. This accession records the licensed digital edition in custody.
preservation.availability: Playable from the archive Steam library for as long as that license and the required online services remain intact.

connections.futureReview: Reserved for future critical writing in Bloodsoaked Media.

stewardshipHistory.note: Steam library artwork filed under the Library accession path.
Catalog identity, authority references, and digital-holding documentation aligned for publication.
Digital accession curated from Steam custody and set to Catalogued · Permanent Record.

synopsis: SgtOkiDoki’s BattleBit Remastered on Steam — retained as a permanent digital holding under the archive Steam account.
